name: World orchestra
author: moran
description: The world's musical regions on one map. Instruments (on at first): move the mouse, touch, or use the arrow keys, and each region plays a short phrase on a recorded instrument (djembe, kora, oud, balalaika, khomus, morin khuur, sitar, koto, pan flute...). Turn it off and about 280 cities play the data: a city whose value rises past a threshold plays one note in its region's voice.
